javaFollowup.title: Preserve partial Java reference coverage in the combined parsers (R3.12)
javaFollowup.body:
**Roadmap item:** R3.12 — retain incomplete reference-scan coverage after decoder rejection.

**What changed:**

Follow-up to #692 for the combined parser branch in #722. Propagate decoder completeness, keep references already found, continue later methods, and report partial tool coverage. Carry the two class-reference regressions alongside the existing three invocation tests. The modified UTF-8 changes from #690 are preserved.

**Verified:**

The original fix e7cd6da passed full CI: https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/actions/runs/41688827573. The replay diff contains exactly the same three code/test changes, plus ROADMAP and STATUS updates.

**Not verified:**

This combined revision has not executed CI. Its validation remains pending.

- [ ] Formatting, Clippy, tests, layers, locks and secrets on this combined revision.
- [ ] Complete the ROADMAP validation item after CI passes; STATUS records the scope.
- [x] Original implementation; no other project's code, scripts or wording copied.

supportFixes.head: fb1e2fde6b9eabc67b68c6c4e3ad4ba7a666b82c
supportFixes.title: Keep paste cleanup tests independent of clock resolution (R2.9)
supportFixes.body:
**Roadmap item:** R2.9 — make the pasted-picture cleanup regression independent of same-millisecond filename reuse.

**What changed:**

The fixture makes a paste old by changing its modification time, while leaving a current-millisecond filename. Cleanup can remove that file and a new save can legitimately reuse its path, causing the removal assertion to fail. Give the old paste a historical filename and keep the age-based removal, attached-file retention and new-save assertions.

**Verified:**

The failure in #702 was inspected: https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/actions/runs/41687774538. The patch changes the test fixture and its ROADMAP/STATUS records; production code is unchanged.

**Not verified:**

This new revision has not run tests, formatting or Clippy because the execution environment is unavailable. Repository CI is still required.

- [ ] Formatting, Clippy, affected-crate tests, layers, locks and secrets.
- [ ] Complete the ROADMAP validation item after CI passes; STATUS records the pending check.
- [x] Original implementation; no other project's code, scripts or wording copied.

supportFixes.head: 13a0bf438cc740a9db144cc3513eb44551e21aaf
supportFixes.title: Keep builder availability fixtures independent of live discovery (R2.9)
supportFixes.body:
**Roadmap item:** R2.9 — keep the builder-availability smoke regression independent of live agent discovery.

**What changed:**

Opening the builder dialog starts real discovery. A late completion can replace the synthetic results before the test checks Start availability. Mark discovery as already in progress before opening the dialog, then complete it with the existing fixture. Keep the warning, dialog, controls and build-availability assertions.

**Verified:**

The failure in #711 was inspected: https://github.com/storytold/craft-anything/actions/runs/41687928153. Source tracing confirms that headless setup has no prior discovery worker and the guard prevents starting one. The patch changes only this test fixture and ROADMAP/STATUS records.

**Not verified:**

This new revision has not run tests, formatting or Clippy because the execution environment is unavailable. Repository CI is still required.
